svg.text: Microsoft Azure Set | 01 Active Directory in Azure VMs
A Windows Server domain controller (DC-1) and a domain-joined Windows 10 client (Client-1), plus Part 7 bulk user creation with PowerShell.
Microsoft Azureone resource group and virtual network, reused by sections 03 and 04
AD DS and DNS, static IP
You Remote Desktop into Client-1 to test it and later join it to the domain.
Client-1 pings DC-1's static private IP once DC-1's ICMPv4 echo rules are enabled.
You Remote Desktop into DC-1, install AD DS, and promote it to a new forest.
In ADUC on DC-1, create the _EMPLOYEES and _ADMINS OUs and the jane_admin domain admin.
Client-1 uses DC-1 as its DNS server, joins the domain, and moves into the _CLIENTS OU.
On Client-1, the Domain Users group gets Remote Desktop access.
Part 7: jane_admin runs a PowerShell script on DC-1 that bulk-creates users in _EMPLOYEES.
